When AssetContext status is resolved, apply the same success guidance to Canonical asset, Asset criticality, and its Source structural labels. Do not apply resolved guidance when canonical authority is absent.

Use an actual local MUI theme-resolved styling path that is visibly effective in the dark theme, preserving compact uppercase weight line-height and letter-spacing. A data attribute alone is insufficient. Do not change global theme tokens or use hard-coded colors.

Keep all values neutral: fact values text.primary, source names and references neutral or text.secondary as already approved. Critical vendor severity and LOW HIGH CRITICAL criticality values must not inherit success warning or error based on magnitude.
